subject: EU data carve-outs + APAC pilot ramp — renewal and SOW next steps
messages:
From: Anna Kuo <anna.kuo@medistar.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medistar.com>, Kenji Sato <ksato@medistar-apac.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + APAC pilot — data residency questions

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the renewal reminder. A few constraints surfaced on our side as we look to expand into APAC during the renewal window. Key asks from Security/Legal: 1) For EU-resident users, PII must remain in EU (no replication to non-EU regions except for emergency failover). 2) We want an explicit carve-out in the SOW/DPA that permits an APAC pilot for non-production telemetry and de-identified data only. 3) Cross-region failover: acceptable only with documented trigger conditions, timeframe (max 72 hours), and full audit logs + notification to our security team.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a narrow EU-only residency clause plus a staged APAC pilot that keeps PII in the EU? If yes, please share a short MOU/SOW sketch and any SOC2 artifacts we can forward to Legal. Also the team will want to understand pricing impact for the APAC burst capacity during pilot and whether that can be discounted.

We are targeting an internal renewal decision by mid-October, and an APAC pilot start no earlier than Oct 15 conditional on terms.

Thanks — Anna
Anna Kuo
VP IT, Medistar Health
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kuo <anna.kuo@medistar.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + APAC pilot — data residency questions

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up-front: yes, we can define EU-only residency for PII and allow a tightly-scoped APAC pilot for de-identified/non-PII telemetry. We can operationalize cross-region failover with the controls you outlined (triggered failover, 72-hour cap, audit logs + email notification).

I'll attach a draft SOW and our latest SOC2 report for Legal. Two asks from our side: 1) can you confirm the exact definition of PII for this engagement (fields / attributes)? 2) confirm whether Medistar headcount or production traffic will be used during APAC pilot (we recommend avoids production PII).

Propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the MOU and pricing. If the pilot requires burst capacity, I can run a quick pricing sketch for a pilot discount.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Medistar asks — EU carve-out + APAC pilot pricing

Team — copying the thread from Medistar. Key requirements: EU-only residency for PII, APAC pilot limited to de-identified telemetry, cross-region failover allowed under strict conditions (72h, audit, notification). They want SOC2 artifacts + an SOW sketch.

Notes / proposed approach:
- Security/legal: offer DPA addendum with an explicit carve-out clause that states PII never leaves EU except for emergency failover conditions (catalog triggers). For auditability we will log any KV transfers and provide an HMAC-signed audit file.
- Technical: support a regional model pin (EU model variant) for all EU traffic; APAC pilot runs on a separate tenant with pseudonymized payloads. Failover only allowed to regions with approved safeguards.
- Commercial: propose a one-time APAC pilot uplift (metered) and offer 40% pilot discount for first 6 weeks to reduce friction; full price applies post-pilot. Need approval from pricing/legal.
- Docs: share SOC2 + draft SOW + DPA addendum.

Monica — can legal draft the carve-out language and DPA addendum? Marissa — can CS support the pilot plan and run the onboarding checklist (network allowlist, test datasets)? Evelyn — please confirm what telemetry we can allow out of EU (logs, metrics vs. PII).

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Medistar asks — EU carve-out + APAC pilot pricing

On it. Draft language below (high level) — I'll produce a formal DPA addendum doc: 

"Data Residency Carve-Out: For EU residents' Personally Identifiable Information ("PII"), Redwood agrees to store, process, and retain such PII exclusively within the European Economic Area (EEA) unless an emergency failover (as defined below) is invoked. Emergency Failover: Redispatch of workload to non-EEA regions may occur only upon the occurrence of a Service Impact Event impacting Redwood's EU region capacity, after exhaustion of remediation and failover mitigations, and for a maximum period of 72 hours per event. Redwood shall provide Medistar with log exports, a forensics summary, and email notification to security@medistar.com within one hour of invocation.

We should include explicit definitions for PII and the allowed APAC pilot dataset (pseudonymized, no linkable identifiers).

I approve the 40% pilot discount as a one-time commercial concession; legal will prepare the DPA addendum and mark the SOW with the carve-out.
Monica
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kuo <anna.kuo@medistar.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed MOU and MAP for EU carve-out + APAC pilot (attached)

Hi Anna — attaching a short MOU and the SOC2 report. High-level proposal below and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (MAP):

Proposal summary:
- EU PII residency: PII scoped to EEA, enforced via regional model pin and data routing.
- APAC pilot: pilot tenant limited to pseudonymized telemetry and synthetic traffic; pilot window 6 weeks starting Oct 15.
- Failover: permitted only under "Service Impact Event" conditions, 72-hour cap, HMAC-signed audit logs, 1-hour notification.
- Commercial: 40% discount on APAC pilot burst for the pilot window; post-pilot pricing at listed Dedicated/On-demand rates.

Suggested MAP:
1) 9/22: Medistar confirms PII fields and pilot dataset scope
2) 9/24: Redwood sends DPA addendum + SOW draft (attached)
3) 9/29: Legal review complete / commercial sign-off
4) 10/06: Procurement sends PO or redlines
5) 10/15: Pilot ramp begins (6 weeks)

Please find attachments: SOW_Medistar_APAC_Pilot_v1.2.pdf, SOC2_Report_Q2_2026.pdf.

Can you confirm MAP dates or propose edits?

Thanks,
Dylan
From: Anna Kuo <anna.kuo@medistar.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medistar.com>, Kenji Sato <ksato@medistar-apac.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MOU and MAP for EU carve-out + APAC pilot (attached)

Thanks Dylan — reviewed. Procurement delivered two asks: 1) sample clause for "data carve-out" to include in our master order (please include in the DPA addendum). 2) Commercial: they are asking if the APAC pilot discount can be 50% instead of 40% given this is a greenfield region for us.

Security notes: we will provide the PII fields list by 9/24. For the APAC pilot, we confirm the pilot will use synthetic and pseudonymized datasets only.

If we can move the pilot start to Oct 20 (gives procurement more runway), Procurement will prepare an LOI for the pilot. We will need a DocuSign e-sign link for the DPA addendum and SOW.

Best,
Anna
